Psalms 61 · Psalm 61: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I

points: David asks the Most High to hear his cry and attend to his prayer; from the end of the earth he will cry when his heart is overwhelmed, asking to be led to the rock that is higher than himself.

note.label: Psalm 61: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I

points: The Most High has been a shelter for him and a strong tower from the enemy; he will abide in the tabernacle forever and trust in the covert of His wings.

note.label: Psalm 61: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I

points: The Most High has heard David's vows and given him the heritage of those that fear His name, and will prolong the king's life as many generations.

note.label: Psalm 61: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I

points: The king shall abide before God forever; so David will sing praise unto His name forever and daily perform his vows.
